models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6

useCases.label: Main Chat
useCases.desc: Primary assistant for all WhatsApp & UI conversations

models.instructions: Default model for all main session interactions. Handles WhatsApp messages, skill invocations, and general assistant tasks. Reasoning is set to 'off' by default (thinkingDefault=off in config).

models.name: Grok 3

useCases.label: Stock Trading
useCases.desc: Real-time market analysis, buy/sell decisions for the virtual portfolio

useCases.label: Daily Stock Scan
useCases.desc: Daily scanner of 15 stocks/crypto with news, analyst, and technical scores

useCases.label: AI News Summary
useCases.desc: Daily Hebrew AI news digest sent to WhatsApp

useCases.label: Iran Dashboard
useCases.desc: Geopolitical intelligence analysis and threat assessment

models.instructions: Used for all real-time data tasks. Has web access and real-time knowledge. Preferred for financial analysis, news, and geopolitical monitoring. Currently free tier (cost=$0).

models.name: Grok 3 Mini

useCases.label: Light Tasks
useCases.desc: Lightweight tasks that need web access but don't require full Grok 3 power

models.instructions: Smaller, faster version of Grok 3 with reasoning support. Available but not actively used in cron jobs. Good for quick real-time lookups.

models.name: Claude Opus 4.6

useCases.label: Deep Research
useCases.desc: Complex research tasks requiring maximum reasoning depth

useCases.label: Architecture
useCases.desc: System design and architectural decisions via /model opus

useCases.label: Long-form Writing
useCases.desc: High-quality essays, documents, and creative writing

models.instructions: Most powerful Anthropic model. Use sparingly due to high cost ($15/M input, $75/M output). Switch via '/model opus' in chat. Best for tasks where quality matters more than cost.

models.name: Mistral Large

useCases.label: Multilingual
useCases.desc: Strong multilingual support including French, German, Spanish

useCases.label: Fallback
useCases.desc: Alternative when Anthropic rate limits are hit

models.instructions: EU-based model, useful as fallback when Anthropic rate limits are reached. Good multilingual support. Switch via '/model mistral'.

models.name: Mistral Small

useCases.label: Cheap Tasks
useCases.desc: Very low cost tasks where quality is less critical

models.instructions: Cheapest available model ($0.1/M input). Use for high-volume, low-stakes tasks. Not actively used in current setup.

models.name: Gemini 2.0 Flash

useCases.label: Memory Embeddings
useCases.desc: Used internally for semantic search in memory_search tool

useCases.label: Long Context
useCases.desc: 1M token context window for very long documents

models.instructions: Used primarily for memory embeddings (gemini-embedding-001). Also available for long-context tasks thanks to its 1M token window. Very cheap for high-volume use.

switchInstructions.chat: Type '/model <alias>' in any chat to switch models for that session
switchInstructions.cron: Set 'model' field in the cron job payload to override the default model
switchInstructions.config: Set 'agents.defaults.model.primary' in openclaw.json to change the permanent default
